_about: Material per group (limb) for the tetrahedral tissue of the pose-capture investigation (step 11), and the reduced anatomy it is built with. Units: Pa, kg/m3, 1/s, metres. Every group starts from Rafael's rafa8 values (data/body_tissue.json, measured only on the thigh); the breasts and the cavity are by eye. Design: G:\mocap-studio-downloads\review\2026-11-14\pose_capture\10_desenho_tecidos.html. Edit to change; a run can override one as group.key=value, as seio_E.fat_young=2000.
_breasts: seio_E and seio_D: softer and less damped than the rest, by eye, until Rafael's meu_teste values (2026-11-05) are carried over; fat at real fat's density.

mesh._about: Voxel side by depth under the skin (Rafael, 2026-11-14): 3 layers of 3 mm, 3 of 6, 3 of 9, then 12 mm. Six tetrahedra per voxel.

anatomy._about: Reduced anatomy (memory human-restart-reduced-anatomy): rigid capsules along the rig's limb bones, a rigid spine, rib cage and pelvis core, and the belly's cavity, all by eye.
anatomy._shoulder: shoulder.L/R: a capsule along the rig's shoulder bone stands for clavicle and scapula; without it the shoulders were soft muscle only (malha_v3).
